title: How can you get two numbers on one phone?
summary: You can get two phone numbers on one phone in minutes. Compare VoIP apps, dual SIM, and carrier add-ons. See what each option can do.
body_markdown:
Your personal phone number has become your business line, and it’s starting to show. Clients text you after hours, and you hesitate before answering calls from numbers you don’t recognize. You’re always “on,” even when you’re off the clock.


That’s why you’re wondering if you can have two phone numbers on one phone.


The bottom line: **Yes, you can.**


Every smartphone can make calls from two numbers at a time. Some of them can even handle more. Here are three ways to do it:


- **A VoIP app.** These apps provide access to a virtual phone number you own. Calls and texts made with this number are made over the internet using Voice over Internet Protocol, also known as VoIP. You don’t need a SIM card to access your second number.
- **Dual SIM.** Some smartphones offer an extra SIM card slot or eSIM capabilities to users. You can use it to add another SIM you can purchase from your carrier.
- **Carrier add-ons.** The same dual SIM method is available if you pay extra with the same carrier as your cell phone provider, typically $10 to $15 a month. For example, Verizon Second Number adds an extra number to your existing Verizon plan.


Of these three methods, the app route is the fastest to set up. It’s also the only route that lets you share your second number with a team. A cellular number costs more than virtual phone numbers, but it behaves just like your primary number. You can use it for verification codes, which isn’t possible with virtual numbers.


##


Can you really have 2 phone numbers on one phone?


Yes, with most[VoIP systems](https://www.quo.com/features/voip-phone-system) , you can set up more than two phone numbers on one phone. They let you add multiple numbers to your existing device without the need for a second SIM card or a dual-SIM phone. This feature helps separate your personal and business communications.


Compare this easy, flexible option for purchasing a dual SIM phone, which is a type of device that can also support two numbers. Unlike[VoIP phones](https://www.quo.com/blog/what-is-a-voip-phone/) , dual SIM phones limit you to two numbers only, and you typically need to buy separate plans from your carrier for each. Even if you add multiple eSIMs to the same phone, it can be hard to know which conversations belong to which number.


##


3 Ways to get a second phone number on your phone


Here’s a breakdown of each of the methods you can use to get a second phone number:


### 1. Dual SIM phones


A dual SIM phone is a mobile device that supports two SIM cards. Each SIM card connects to its respective mobile network; you can choose to make calls from your second SIM card. Carriers like Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile also offer eSIMs you can add to your phone without needing to buy more physical SIM cards. It’s also convenient if you’re traveling and need to quickly get a local SIM in your destination country.


If you’re looking to[get a second phone number](https://www.quo.com/blog/get-second-phone-number/) to share with your team, though, dual SIM phones fall short. They’re locked to an individual device, so your team can’t access it easily. Setup time can also take hours if you have to purchase a new SIM from your carrier.


### 2. Carrier add-on services


Some mobile carriers let you add an[alternate phone number](https://www.quo.com/blog/alternate-phone-number/) for an additional monthly fee. These services typically include basic calling and texting, but they don’t offer any way to save time catching up on conversations or automating phone-related tasks.


Keep in mind carriers offer a second phone number as an add-on using dual SIM technology. For example, Verizon offers[Verizon Second Number](https://www.quo.com/blog/verizon-second-number-alternatives/) . This service lets you get a different phone number on your existing device and avoid[carrying two phones](https://www.quo.com/blog/carrying-two-phones/) . It comes with basic features like unlimited talk and text in the US, Canada, and Mexico. This allows you to make and receive calls and texts from your primary number and your second phone number[without switching SIM cards](https://www.quo.com/blog/how-to-call-without-sim-card/) .


Like dual SIM phones, setup time can take longer. If your phone can’t support eSIM or an additional SIM card, you’ll need a separate device.


### 3. VoIP apps


VoIP phones allow you to send and receive calls and texts with an internet connection. They don’t require custom hardware and don’t rely on telecom carrier networks to handle calls. VoIP phones offer more business-friendly features, like sharing numbers with coworkers, integrating with tools like CRMs, and using AI-powered features.


Of the three options in this list, VoIP apps are the easiest to set up. Just download a provider’s app, create an account, and select your preferred phone number. You can start making calls immediately from any available device, including tablets and laptops.

VoIP vs dual SIM phones: What’s better?


If you’re looking for ways to add another number to your phone, you have two options: VoIP phones and dual SIM phones.


Here’s an overview of the differences:

Number of lines Unlimited Two only

Here are a few reasons why VoIP is better than dual SIM to manage multiple business numbers:


1. **Scale without limits.** VoIP phones let you add as many different numbers as you want.[Add specific phone numbers](https://www.quo.com/blog/get-specific-phone-number/) with local area codes to build trust in new markets. Offer dedicated numbers to your sales and support teams.


Phones with dual SIM cards limit you to two numbers, which can affect your phone’s battery life and storage space. You also need to buy separate plans for each SIM card. Since only one mobile number can receive calls and messages at a time, you could miss important calls.
2. **Share numbers with your team.** You can only share a dual SIM phone with your team by handing them your device. VoIP phones allow you to[share your numbers](https://www.quo.com/blog/how-to-share-a-business-phone-number-with-your-team/) virtually. Incoming calls ring all members of your team, and everyone can view your customer interactions.

Sync call activity to your CRM, set up automated text workflows, and record and summarize calls with AI. That way, you spend less time on manual tasks and more on growing your business faster.


Dual SIM phones have one advantage over VoIP apps. Dual SIM phones can send verification codes because they’re linked to carrier-based numbers. Virtual numbers aren’t recognized by institutions like banks and ride-hailing apps since they’re easy to acquire. If you need an additional number to accept verification codes for personal use, opt for a dual SIM-compatible phone.


##


Practical considerations for managing two numbers on one phone


If you’re new to having two phone numbers on the same device, you might have some questions about day-to-day use. Here are the most common questions we get:


### Do the two numbers share contacts?


With a dual SIM phone, both numbers use your phone’s address book. Your contacts and conversations happen between both numbers simultaneously. Your call history will show which number took the call, but you can’t easily tell the difference between the two.


With a VoIP app, your provider stores a separate contact list in your account. With some providers like Quo, you can choose to sync your personal contacts with the app, but you can also keep them separate.


### How do you know which number someone called?


Dual SIM phones label the specific number that handled the call in your call history. App-based calls arrive in the app, so the separation is obvious by default. VoIP apps like Quo also label incoming calls in your caller ID so you know which calls are for work.


### How do you choose which number you’re calling from?


Dual SIM phones make you choose a default number to make and receive calls. When you dial a contact, it automatically defaults to that number. You risk making work calls from your personal number.


VoIP apps make calls from your chosen number. You can also switch numbers in the platform as needed.


### What happens to voicemail?


Each number gets its own voicemail. On a cellular second line, that means two carrier voicemail boxes to check. In a VoIP app, voicemail lives in the app, usually with a transcript.

##


Frequently asked questions about second phone numbers


**Is it legal to have two phone numbers on one phone?**


Yes, it’s legal to have two numbers on the same phone. It’s standard practice in the US and Canada to separate work and personal calls. You can add more than two numbers on the same phone if needed.


**How many phone numbers can one phone have?**


iOS devices can support[eight or more eSIMs,](https://www.airalo.com/blog/how-many-esims-can-my-iphone-have?srsltid=AfmBOophrFku6a5FnLSKTaZxvmalN-iBYA_ly0OzfTsqwLpuJzkJtTYd) and Android phones can support up to[20 eSIMs](https://www.samsung.com/ae/support/mobile-devices/what-is-the-maximum-number-of-esim-profiles-for-my-galaxy-device/) . However, you can only have two active numbers operating simultaneously.


****What are the disadvantages of dual SIM phones?****


While dual SIM phones let you use two numbers on one device, you’ll need to pay for a separate voice and data plan. It can be more expensive than a VoIP service.


Dual SIM phones are more difficult to manage. You may need to ensure you’re using the intended number before you send a message, make a call, or use data. This can lead to confusion and missed messages.


They also drain the battery faster, as your phone constantly connects to two networks.


****Can I use my second number for international calls?****


Yes, you can use a[virtual phone number](https://www.quo.com/blog/get-virtual-phone-number/) to make international calls, as long as you are connected to the internet with WiFi or cellular data. With Quo, you’ll get affordable[international calling rates](https://www.quo.com/rates) .


****How much does it cost to have 2 numbers on 1 phone?****


A VoIP service can make a second phone number more affordable than alternative options. While buying a new cell phone or paying off your device to unlock it for dual SIM can cost several hundred dollars, VoIP services only charge a small monthly price per user.


Quo, for example, starts at $15 per user per month, with one free phone number included with every user. Dual SIM carrier add-ons like Verizon Second Number cost $10–$15 per number per month. On top of that, you may have to get a dual SIM phone, which can cost $150–$500+, depending on your preferred model.


As your small business grows and needs more advanced phone features, you can upgrade without spending hundreds on new phones for each team member.


****What will my outgoing caller ID look like on my second number?****


VoIP service providers allow you to set up a Caller ID Name, or CNAM, in your business phone settings. With a CNAM, your name or business name will show up when you call from your second number.


Your outgoing caller ID can be up to 15 characters, including letters and spaces. You must be authorized to use your Caller ID Name, so there’s no pretending to be the government or a competitor.


****How do I switch between numbers when making calls?****


With a VoIP app, you don’t need to switch between different phone numbers. To make a business call, you open the VoIP mobile app and dial. To make a personal call, you use your phone’s regular dialer. The app keeps everything separate for you, so you don’t have to remember to toggle a setting before you call.


****What happens to my second number if I change phones?****


That’s the best part about a VoIP number — it’s not tied to your device. If you get a new phone, you just download Quo, sign in to your account, and your business number is right there. All your contacts, messages, and call history are there too. No need to port numbers or call your carrier.


**Can I port my existing number to be my second number?**


Yes, you can easily port your existing number to be your second number. VoIP apps offer[phone number porting](https://www.quo.com/blog/whats-phone-number-porting/) services that let you keep using your existing number without affecting your communications. You can start the porting process with your new provider. Quo’s guided porting process only takes five steps.

1.[Create an account with Quo](https://my.quo.com/signup) by using your email address or Google account.
2. Pick your preferred phone number.
3. Complete the sign-up process, and the number is yours.


Once you’re finished, you’re all set to download the Quo Android app from the Google Play Store.


****Can you get two phone numbers on one iPhone?****


Yes, it’s easy to set up a secondary number on your iPhone with Quo:


1.[Sign up for a Quo account](https://my.quo.com/signup) using your email.
2. Choose your new phone number.
3. Complete the sign-up process, and your second number is ready to use.


After that, simply download the Quo app from the App Store, and you’re set to make calls, send texts, and manage both numbers from one device.


****Can you use two different phone numbers with WhatsApp on one device?****


Yes, WhatsApp allows you to manage two different phone numbers on one device for dual SIM phones. However, you can only be verified on WhatsApp with one registered phone number. Learn more about[multi-number management in WhatsApp](https://faq.whatsapp.com/1068436057886812) .
